Package com.egradx.auth.oidc

Class EgradxOidcService

java.lang.Object
com.egradx.auth.oidc.EgradxOidcService
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.springframework.beans.factory.Aware, org.springframework.context.ApplicationEventPublisherAware
public class EgradxOidcService extends Object implements org.springframework.context.ApplicationEventPublisherAware
Signing in with OpenID Connect providers — Google, Zoho, or any other configured — and linking them to accounts (docs/auth/sign-in-methods.md).

A round trip is: start(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.util.UUID) (the browser is sent to the provider), callback(java.lang.String, java.util.Map<java.lang.String, java.lang.String>) (the provider sends it back; what it proved is stored under a one-time result code and the browser is sent to the frontend), then exchange(java.lang.String, java.util.UUID, java.lang.String) (the frontend trades the result code for a session). Every step keeps its state in the database, so each may reach a different instance.

    • start

      @Transactional public String start(String providerId, String returnTo, UUID linkUserId)
      Starts a round trip to the provider and returns where to send the browser.
      Parameters:
      returnTo - a path on the frontend to come back to; anything else is dropped
      linkUserId - to link the provider to this signed-in account, rather than sign in
      Throws:
      NotFoundException - OIDC_PROVIDER_UNKNOWN
      ValidationException - OIDC_FAILED when the provider's discovery document cannot be read

    • callback

      @Transactional public String callback(String providerId, Map<String,String> parameters)
      The provider's callback: checks it and returns where on the frontend to send the browser — with code (to exchange), linked (a provider linked from the profile), or error. Never throws.
      Parameters:
      parameters - the callback's query parameters

    • exchange

      @Transactional(noRollbackFor=ValidationException.class) public EgradxAuthResult exchange(String code, UUID organizationId, String invitationToken)
      Trades the result code for a session — or says why not. A code that ends in SIGNUP_REQUIRED or ORG_SELECTION_REQUIRED stays usable for the next step.
      Throws:
      ValidationException - OIDC_CODE_INVALID, OIDC_EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED, ORG_SELECTION_REQUIRED
      DuplicateResourceException - IDENTITY_LINK_REQUIRED, SIGNUP_REQUIRED
      AuthorizationException - AUTH_NO_ACCOUNT, ORG_ACCESS_DENIED, ORG_SUSPENDED

    • signup

      @Transactional public EgradxAuthResult signup(String code, String organizationName)
      Signs up with the provider's verified email, after SIGNUP_REQUIRED: an account with no password, a new organization it administers, the provider linked, and a session there.
      Throws:
      AuthorizationException - SIGNUP_DISABLED
      ValidationException - OIDC_CODE_INVALID, OIDC_EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED, SIGNUP_EMAIL_DOMAIN_NOT_ALLOWED
      DuplicateResourceException - EMAIL_IN_USE, ORGANIZATION_NAME_IN_USE, IDENTITY_IN_USE

    • unlink

      @Transactional public void unlink(UUID userId, UUID organizationId, UUID identityId)
      Removes a linked provider.
      Throws:
      NotFoundException - when it is not one of the person's
      ValidationException - SIGN_IN_METHOD_REQUIRED when it would leave them no way to sign in
